:::{#def-exp-reg}
#### Exponential regression model

An **exponential regression model** for an event time $T$
with [predictor](Intro-to-GLMs.qmd#def-predictors) vector $\vx$
assumes that,
given $\vx$,
$T$ has an [exponential distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-exponential)
whose [hazard rate](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-hazard) is
the exponentiated [linear predictor](Intro-to-GLMs.qmd#def-linear-predictor):

$$
\haz(t \mid \vx) \eqdef \expf{\eta(\vx)},
\quad \eta(\vx) \eqdef \vx \cdot \vb = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_1 + \dots + \beta_p x_p
$$ {#eq-exp-reg-haz}

:::
